data.title: Come As You Are
data.author_note:
Here's my take on Nirvana - Come As You Are. 

Album audio is pitch corrected from A444 to A440. FHP and finger placement are generally based on how they seem to play it live. Some partial strums in the guitar charts have been merged into the prevailing handshape for chart readability.

Lead - as expected. Shifts to the distortion tone and includes the solo. 
Rhythm - as expected. Plays the clean layer for the duration as heard on the album recording. 
Bass - as expected. Recording studio logs indicate Bass was triple tracked (D Std, an octave higher, and an octave lower) with the goal of giving it a "12-string" feel. Accordingly, the charted tone has a bit of octave mixed in. In live video he seems to generally play the 2E notes during the Pre-Chorus with finger 3, but the chart suggests finger 2 due to RS constraints.

Please let me know if you spot any need for corrections. Constructive feedback is encouraged and appreciated. Enjoy!

data.title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
data.author_note:
v1.0a Update - only changed the Album Art to match the ODLC charts from the same album. No changes to the actual chart.

------------------------------------------------------------------

Here's my take on Nirvana - Smells Like Teen Spirit.

Guitar tones crafted using the closet RS analogs to what was allegedly used in the studio:  Fender Bassman, Mesa/Boogie Studio Pre, 4x12 with V30s, Boss DS-1, and EHX Small Clone Chorus.

Hat-tip to Djpavs and Emmy-Dell for testing feedback.

Lead - as expected. On all guitar paths, there are a few spots with small variations in the main riff.
Rhythm - as expected.
Alt Rhythm - plays an additional layered track where appropriate.
Bass - as expected. Note that during the "main" riff, he plays the A string notes (Bb at 1A and Db at 4A) with a bit of "swing" feel.

Please let me know if you spot any need for corrections. Constructive feedback is encouraged and appreciated. Enjoy!
